title: Cloud Logging Export Sink and Exclusion Filter

Confirm UC-4.3.17 returns >=1 row and the alert fires.
controlTest.negativeScenario: Replay benign `google:gcp:pubsub:message` traffic without `protoPayload.serviceName="logging.googleapis.com" (protoPayload.methodName="CreateSink" OR protoPayload.methodName="UpdateSink" OR protoPayload.methodName="DeleteSink")`. Confirm UC-4.3.17 returns zero rows and the alert does not fire.

detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=gcp`.
• Install and configure `Splunk_TA_google-cloudplatform` with the modular input for `google:gcp:pubsub:message`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.3.41.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `messageId` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Forward audit logs. Alert on CreateSink, UpdateSink, DeleteSink. Track sink destinations and filters. Ensure critical sinks (e.g. to Pub/Sub for Splunk) are not modified without change control.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=gcp sourcetype="google:gcp:pubsub:message" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=gcp sourcetype="google:gcp:pubsub:message" protoPayload.serviceName="logging.googleapis.com" (protoPayload.methodName="CreateSink" OR protoPayload.methodName="UpdateSink" OR protoPayload.methodName="DeleteSink")
| table _time messageId publishTime attributes
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.3.17_cloud_logging_export_sin_17"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `google:gcp:pubsub:message` in `index=gcp` to detect cloud logging export sink and exclusion filter. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the provider cloud console audit view for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `messageId` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_3_17_alert` with severity aligned to `medium` criticality. Dashboard: Table (who, what, sink), Timeline (sink changes), Single value (sink count)..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade `Splunk_TA_google-cloudplatform` and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch cloud logs for signs of cloud logging export sink and exclusion filter so your team catches problems in your online services before customers or auditors do.
